items.title: Modder brings full Nvidia DLSS 5 suite to three generations of AMD gaming GPUs
items.summary: Radeon GPUs get the full DLSS experience as solo project ports all the DLSS features for RDNA2-4 GPUs.

confirmed_facts.text: Modder brings full Nvidia DLSS 5 suite to three generations of AMD gaming GPUs — plans to match native Nvidia GPU performance Radeon users finally get to enjoy more DLSS features.

items.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
items.summary: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

confirmed_facts.text: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg - Published At least one person has been killed in an overnight attack on St Petersburg that successfully targeted two of the city's oil facilities.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg - Published At least one person has been killed in an overnight attack on St Petersburg that successfully targeted two of the city's oil facilities.

confirmed_facts.text: The region's Governor Alexander Beglov said fires were being extinguished at the St Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchyi oil depot following the attack, which also injured at least five.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The region's Governor Alexander Beglov said fires were being extinguished at the St Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchyi oil depot following the attack, which also injured at least five.

confirmed_facts.text: A logistics centre belonging to Ozon - known as Russia's Amazon - and a data centre belonging to Facebook equivalent VKontakte were also hit.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: A logistics centre belonging to Ozon - known as Russia's Amazon - and a data centre belonging to Facebook equivalent VKontakte were also hit.

confirmed_facts.text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday morning that Russia had targeted his country's energy sector 76 times since Donald Trump declared an "energy ceasefire" last week.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday morning that Russia had targeted his country's energy sector 76 times since Donald Trump declared an "energy ceasefire" last week.

confirmed_facts.text: Ukraine had paused its strikes on Russian oil facilities - which it says are to limit the main revenue stream for Moscow's war effort - for three days after the announcement, while accusing Russia of continuing.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ukraine had paused its strikes on Russian oil facilities - which it says are to limit the main revenue stream for Moscow's war effort - for three days after the announcement, while accusing Russia of continuing.

confirmed_facts.text: It then resumed strikes earlier this week, drawing the ire of Trump, who called for a truce to facilitate a deal he struck with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin to supply diesel.
